title: On the Cultural Anachronism and Temporal Reasoning in Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating vision-language models on multiple-choice temporal reasoning tasks using a curated benchmark of Indian cultural artifacts (TAB-VLM) and comparing the performance against a pilot dataset of Western artifacts to expose representational gaps and biases against non-Western heritage.

Assessing models' tendency for 'cultural anachronism' (projecting modern or inappropriate contemporary frameworks onto historical artifacts) through six specialized tasks including chronological sequencing, period intrusion detection, and historical material availability.
